summary.text: Mike Fox is a Democratic state representative from Montana who has represented House District 32 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Coast Guard and Montana Army National Guard veteran who worked in tribal law enforcement, he served in the Montana Senate from 2021 to 2025 and sits on the House Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Mike Fox lives in Hays, Montana, and graduated from Harlem High School.
He served in the U.S. Coast Guard for four years and the Montana Army National Guard for 20 years.
His career experience includes working with tribal law enforcement and serving as chair of Island Mountain Development Corp.
Fox won the November 3, 2020 general election for Montana State Senate District 16 and served in the Senate from 2021 to 2025.
He then defeated Jason Ulrich in the November 5, 2024 general election for House District 32 and assumed office in the House on January 6, 2025.
In the 2025-2026 session he is assigned to the Appropriations Committee.
